entities.name: Spread of Islam
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The rapid expansion of Islam from Arabia across the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and parts of Europe and Southeast Asia (632 CE onwards). Achieved through conquest, trade, and cultural exchange.
